name: bar-close
scene: A small night cafe at closing time: worn wooden counter, three warm pendant bulbs, a cold blue rain-streaked window, glass jars, a small chalkboard menu with illegible marks, a folded cloth and two cooled cups slightly out of place.
pose: She stands behind the counter, one forearm resting along the wood, the other hand wrapped around a cream stoneware mug with the handle facing her and a thumb over the rim. Ears relaxed and angled slightly forward, head turned a little to her right, eyes looking down and away across the room at the work, not into the lens.

name: street-lamp
scene: A wet city street at night under a single sodium streetlamp: rain-slick asphalt, one shallow puddle mirroring a lit shop sign, one warm lit window across the street, a scuffed delivery box on the curb, no crowds.
pose: She stands still under the lamp, chin slightly lifted, eyes looking up the street ahead at the route rather than at the lens. One hand holds a thin brass key pinched at the fingertips, palm open to the light.
